# Decision register

*Generated by `scripts/docs-decisions.py` from the three ADR ledgers and `docs/reference/decisions-implementation.yaml`. Do not edit by hand; regenerate with `mise run docs-decisions`.*

This page lists every architecture decision record in Unfold's three ledgers: [system](../adr/index.md), [Ploeg](../../apps/ploeg/docs/adrs/README.md) and [Unfold](../../apps/unfold/docs/adrs/README.md). Each ledger stays the source; this page is regenerated from them and fails `mise run docs-check` when it drifts.

An accepted record states why a rule exists. A proposed record is an open question, even when code already implements it.
